Title: Making Myself at Home
Text:
I've been assigned a room at the State Hotel. I should find it using the room number written on my furniture package.

Once inside my room, I can open the package by right-clicking with it in my hand.
CompleteText: I've found my room and unpacked my furniture. I finally have the essentials to start making myself at home in Gramados.

QuestManual.Slot: Open the package in your room
